<infobox theme="Currency">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group>
    	<header>Financial information</header>
        <data source="type"><label>Type of currency</label></data>
        <data source="forms"><label>Forms of currency</label></data>	
        <data source="value"><label>Value</label></data>
    </group>
    <group>
    	<header>Historical information</header>
        <data source="time"><label>Time of use</label></data>
        <data source="first"><label>First used</label></data>
        <data source="last"><label>Last used</label></data>
    </group>
    <group>
    	<header>Other information</header>
        <data source="location"><label>Location(s)</label></data>
        <data source="affiliation"><label>Affiliation</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Currency|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.
